Chrome Web Store listing optimization from Ecom Swift LLC rewrites your title and descriptions, designs clean screenshots and a promo tile, and explains each permission in plain words so visitors feel safe installing.

## Why does a Chrome Web Store listing matter?

Your Chrome Web Store listing is often the only thing a person sees before deciding to install your extension. They read the title, scan the short description, look at the screenshots and check the permissions. If any of those is unclear, they go back to the search results and pick another tool.

The listing also decides whether people find you at all. The store matches searches against your words, so the terms you use and where you put them shape which searches can reach you.

## How a clear listing helps installs and trust

Installs depend on three things: being found, being understood and being trusted. A title written with the right search term helps you be found. Screenshots with short captions help the visitor understand what the extension does in a few seconds. Plain permission notes and an honest privacy section help them trust it.

Many listings lose people at the permission screen, because a warning appears without any context. When the listing already explains why an extension needs access to a site, the warning feels expected rather than alarming. We cannot control store rankings, and results vary with competition and reviews, but a clearer page gives your listing a better chance of turning a view into an install.

## What a complete listing includes

- A title that names the tool and the main use, written for real searches.
- A short description that fits the store's limit and says what the extension does.
- A long description with a clear opening, feature sections and honest limits.
- Search terms placed naturally, with no repeated keyword lists.
- Screenshots that show the real interface and one benefit each.
- Short captions that explain what the viewer is looking at.
- A small promo tile, and a large one in the top package.
- Permission explanations in everyday language.
- Draft answers for the privacy tab that match what the code does.
- A listing check against the store's content rules.

## How we do the work

We start with your current listing, the extension itself and the words people use to describe the problem it solves. Then we draft the text, choose the search terms and plan the screenshots. We build images from the real interface so that nobody feels misled, and we write permission notes in plain language.

The packages build upward. Basic delivers the title, descriptions, search terms and permission reasons as a document you paste in. Standard adds five designed screenshots with captions, a small promo tile and drafted privacy answers. Premium adds a large promo tile, a video script, two title options to test, upload to your dashboard and a rules check.

We write original text and never copy another extension's wording.

## Do and avoid on a store page

**Do:**
- Lead with what the extension does, in the user's words.
- Show the real product in every screenshot.
- Explain each permission in a sentence.
- Keep claims you can prove and drop the rest.
- Update the listing whenever a feature changes.

**Avoid:**
- Stuffing the title with a string of keywords.
- Mentioning other brands to attract their searches.
- Using screenshots that show features you do not have.
- Writing a privacy answer that does not match the code.
- Leaving the default text from a template in the description.

## Who this is for

It suits a developer who built a good extension but is not a writer or designer. It suits an owner whose installs stay low despite useful features. And it suits a company preparing a relaunch that wants the page to match a new interface.

## What we need from you

Send the store link or the extension build, a list of the main features, your target audience and any brand files. Tell us the terms people might use to describe the problem.

We never ask for passwords. You can paste in the text and images we deliver, or add us to your developer dashboard at the access level it offers if you choose the package that uploads. After you order, we reply with a short checklist and begin with the research.
